Class ChooseShipPieceState

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.galaxytruckers.server.model.state.GameState

it.polimi.ingsw.galaxytruckers.server.model.state.ChooseShipPieceState
All Implemented Interfaces:
GameStateInterface
public final class ChooseShipPieceState extends AdventureState implements GameStateInterface
Represents a state in which the player can choose a ship piece to keep. This state is part of the adventure phase where players select pieces for their ship when it becomes disconnected or damaged.
